# Minnie Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Described as a model pupil, Minnie Andrews is considered a very nice little girl by others. However, she is also seen as dull and poky, lacking both imagination and a spark of life, and rarely seems to have a good time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Minnie Andrews attended school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) alongside classmates like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She joined her fellow students in warmly welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to school after a period of absence. Later, Minnie and her peers witnessed the departure of their teacher, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), as he delivered his farewell speech on the final day of the school term.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVII.
